remarks: Sunny 3 bedroom 2.5 bath unit at Greenwich Hills offers fully equipped kitchen, dining area with slider to peaceful patio to enjoy the outdoors and spacious living room completes the main level. The second level offers a primary bedroom with full bath plus two additional bedrooms with Marble hall bath with whirlpool. Lower level has spacious laundry room and family room. Furnished (furniture pictured in listing will stay) or Unfurnished. Two unassigned parking spaces included, as well as, pool and tennis. No Smoking and No Pets allowed. Tenant must follow Greenwich Hills Rules.
